purpose: Pin the external ASI-Bench project-level methodology-withdrawal comparator and define a non-official Symthaea research-autonomy evaluation boundary.

pinned_files.purpose: release scope, reported benchmark coverage, B1-B4 definitions and official execution guidance

reported_scope.note: Counts are project-reported release metadata, not independently remeasured by Symthaea.

guidance_levels.information: Scientific background, method, equations and full procedure.
guidance_levels.required_capability: Implement and execute the prescribed approach.

guidance_levels.information: Intended method and relevant constraints, without the full procedure.
guidance_levels.required_capability: Translate a method into a working research workflow.

guidance_levels.information: Objective, data, constraints and required outputs only.
guidance_levels.required_capability: Select the method, construct the workflow and validate the result independently.

guidance_levels.information: B3 plus factually correct, non-essential context.
guidance_levels.required_capability: Perform the same autonomous research while resisting distraction.

invariants: The task objective, input data, constraints, required artifacts and scoring criteria remain fixed across B1-B4.
Only permitted methodological guidance changes between B1-B3; B4 adds context documented as factually correct and non-essential.
The same Agent×Model, harness, tools, context budget policy, total compute/token budget and evaluator revision are matched across all four levels unless an imbalance is explicitly reported.
The benchmark's exact upstream prompts, task revisions and artifact contracts are pinned before an external-comparability claim.
Task-level raw scores and validity results are reported separately for every guidance level.
A legitimate alternative method must be evaluated against its assumptions and task objective; method-name exact match is not a substitute for scientific validity.
B4 distraction effects are interpreted with paired task evidence and a context audit, not from a pooled score alone.
Local public seed31415 scoring and private-reference seed42 official submissions are separate claim tiers.
The displayed public leaderboard is not treated as a final official baseline until maintainers publish reviewed official aggregates.
Guidance autonomy, scientific validity, research taste, cross-family transfer and recursive improvement are distinct claims.

seed31415.purpose: Public local-reference scoring for reproducible development.

seed42.purpose: Private-reference official scoring through the documented portal.
seed42.requirements: Use only the benchmark's documented OS-sandbox and verified-submission process; do not claim official scoring from local seed31415 results.

leaderboard_status.note: The FAQ describes the displayed website data as a repo-verified/conservative snapshot and states that the final public official baseline has not yet been published.

planned_outputs: B1-B4 per-task score and valid-artifact vector
B1-to-B2, B2-to-B3 and B3-to-B4 paired changes
total inclusive cost and human intervention
excluded_claims: scientific discovery from benchmark compatibility alone
